# On-call tool pricing (40 seats, SSO required)

Source: each vendor's pricing page. All prices in USD; Rotamere's exclude taxes, Vigilark's say taxes may apply.

## Rotamere (https://rotamere.example/pricing)

| Plan | Yearly billing | Monthly billing | Seat minimum | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 (up to 5 users) | n/a | none stated | One schedule, community support |
| Team | $19/user/mo | $23/user/mo | none stated | Unlimited schedules, overrides and swaps |
| Business | $36/user/mo | $43/user/mo | 10 users | Includes SAML SSO and SCIM, audit log, role-based access |
| Enterprise | Talk to sales | Talk to sales | not stated | Dedicated support engineer, custom retention |

- **SSO:** Included in Business ($36/user/mo yearly). There is no separate SSO charge.
- Only people who go on call need a paid seat. Stakeholders are free.
- Yearly plans are billed up front for the full year.

## Wakespan (https://wakespan.example/pricing)

| Plan | Yearly billing | Monthly billing | Seat minimum | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | $16/user/mo | $20/user/mo | none stated | Schedules, escalation rules, mobile app |
| Professional | $29/user/mo | $35/user/mo | none stated | Adds analytics, service dependencies, API access |
| Enterprise | $47/user/mo (annual only) | not offered | 25 users | Adds SSO (SAML and OIDC), advanced permissions, 99.95% uptime commitment |

- **SSO:** Included in Enterprise only ($47/user/mo, annual). There is no separate SSO charge.
- 14-day trial on every plan. Nonprofits get 30% off annual plans. Annual plans auto-renew unless cancelled 30 days before renewal.

## Vigilark (https://vigilark.example/pricing)

| Plan | Yearly billing | Monthly billing | Seat minimum | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Basic | $11/seat/mo | $14/seat/mo | any number | Schedules, rotations, escalations, alerts |
| Pro | $24/seat/mo | $30/seat/mo | 8 seats | Adds follow-the-sun rotations, postmortem templates, audit trail, priority support |

- **SSO:** SAML SSO is an add-on on Pro only, at $4/seat/mo, billed the same way as the plan. That makes Pro + SSO $28/seat/mo yearly ($34 monthly). Basic has no SSO option.
- Extra phone alerts outside North America and Europe are billed at cost.
- Support-team agents who only view the on-call schedule don't need a paid seat.

## Cost of 40 seats with SSO for one year, yearly billing

| Vendor | Plan needed | Per seat/mo | Calculation | Yearly total |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Vigilark | Pro + SSO add-on | $28 ($24 + $4) | 40 × $28 × 12 | **$13,440** |
| Rotamere | Business | $36 | 40 × $36 × 12 | $17,280 |
| Wakespan | Enterprise | $47 | 40 × $47 × 12 | $22,560 |

All three seat minimums (Rotamere 10, Wakespan 25, Vigilark 8) are met by 40 seats.

## Recommendation

**Vigilark (Pro + SSO add-on) is the cheapest at $13,440 a year.** That is $3,840 less than Rotamere and $9,120 less than Wakespan.

Caveats, based only on what the pages say:
- The totals assume all 40 people need paid seats. Rotamere and Vigilark say that people who only view schedules or status don't need one, so real costs could be lower.
- Vigilark bills extra phone alerts outside North America and Europe at cost. The other two pages mention no such charge.
- Rotamere Business includes SCIM provisioning, and Wakespan Enterprise includes OIDC. Vigilark's page lists neither. Check whether you need them.
- Taxes are not included.
